checks.detail: Fourth Round active: month 14 of 120 (Census), 7 (state data).
Latest Census data is 2 months old (normal lag is 1–3).
Latest state permit data (NJ DCA) is 9 months old (normal lag is 8–10).
564 of 564 towns matched to at least one permit source.
Towns holding 74% of the obligation have usable state permit data since July 2025, and 53% reported at least 75% of months to Census. Warns only when neither source covers 60%.
164 of 195 towns with both sources usable fall in the same class; 31 disagree.
0 towns had negative homes permitted since July 2025 (clipped to 0).
Latest completions data (NJ DCA certificates of occupancy) is 9 months old (normal lag is 8–10). Completions are a secondary layer.
Permits × 20% is a yardstick for affordable output, not a measure of it. Reviewed by hand each month (data/review_log.md).
